mapper.select: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agenteam_installation) AS record_count, i.installation_id, i.edition, i.initial_enterprise_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enterprise) AS enterprise_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_super_admin_lock) AS administrator_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enterprise e WHERE e.id = i.initial_enterprise_id) AS initial_enterprise_count FROM (SELECT 1 AS id) singleton LEFT JOIN agenteam_installation i ON i.id = singleton.id
